final_sql:
```sql
SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.SchoolID = f.SchoolID
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 'Yes'
AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Direct'
AND s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';
```
